Description: A letter of credit for a purchase, from the request to its issuance by the bank (13m section 5.5, 14m).
An amendment of an issued letter of credit (CHILD_AMENDMENT).
A document from the bank about an issued letter of credit (CHILD_STANDARD).
A SWIFT message about an issued letter of credit (CHILD_STANDARD).
A request to the treasury without an approval (GENERIC_SIMPLE).
A request to the treasury approved by the requester's manager first (GENERIC_APPROVAL).
A proforma invoice for a customer, prepared, reviewed and approved by the sales and issued by the treasury with its number (14m FR-LCE-001 to 008).
A sales order earmarked against a received letter of credit, within its available balance (14m FR-LCE-013, 014).
The collection documents of a received letter of credit, prepared by the treasury and handed to the sales; converts the earmarks into a drawing (14m FR-LCE-016 to 018).
